name: Pipeline Review Gates
description: Configurable CEO review checkpoints in the pipeline — pause at any phase, view deliverables, provide feedback or chat with agents before approving the next phase.
brief:
Add review gates to the pipeline so the CEO can specify which phases require their review, view deliverables inline, and provide feedback before the pipeline continues.
